props.text: PASS labels mark expected containment: pills and text should stay inside controls, wrap rows should not overlap, and narrow controls should clip badge text instead of losing the badge.
PASS: summary badges remain visible and clipped inside their parents.
PASS: standalone badge text stays inside each pill; narrow flow wraps without overlap.
PASS: button labels yield space to badges; badges stay clipped inside narrow buttons.
Long label gives way before colliding with the badge.
Narrow selected tab keeps a clipped badge.
PASS: tab accents, labels, and badges align without overlap or missing badges.
PASS: nav labels do not push badges past the sidebar edge; active accent remains separate.

dirty.note: DragonGUI applies coarse dirty flags immediately; this history records the recent command reasons that triggered them.
